quote: > **`hook`** writes nothing to stderr and always exits 0. **`mcp`** writes only MCP frames on stdout. Neither has a human design surface.

claim: The MCP error results, the handler fault and the owed witness of an over-`MAX_FRAME` line before `initialize` must keep stdout to MCP frames only, and any `Display` change or enumeration reaching `viola hook` must leave its stderr empty and its exit 0.
